jobs.occupation: OPEN application - Data Center Technician to a World Leading Tech Company
jobs.description:
This advert is published due to recurring requests for candidates within this role. It helps us build a pipeline so we can act quickly when we receive a new assignment.
When we get a relevant request from a client, we will review applications from this ad and contact candidates whose profile matches the specific requirements. This also means you may not hear from us in between, as there may be no active assignment at the time.
Demand for this role can change quickly, and during the summer period it may not always be active.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
On behalf of one of the world’s leading and most recognized tech companies, we are looking for two skilled Data Center Technician to their Data Center in Gävle Sweden. If you are looking for a unique career opportunity, that will provide you with many chances to learn, grow and further develop your skills within IT, Support, Hardware, Servers and more than this could be the right role for you.
You will play a vital part in making the Data Centers daily operations run smoothly. The team you will be joining covers the below responsibilities:
Prepares, stages, sets up, and performs startups and shutdowns (e.g., racks, hard drives, switches) according to specific instructions, checklists, guides, standard protocols, and emails.
Performs post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components.
Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, OS rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.

Requirements:
Basic knowledge of computer hardware, servers, and components.
1+ year(s) experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
Basic understanding of how to use Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Excel, Word).
High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.
CompTIA / CCNA/ CDCP would be highly beneficial.
To be considered for this role, you must hold a Swedish passport or permanent residency (PR).

We can offer you:
Attractive working conditions
Employment at one of the world’s most recognizes companies who over and over is celebrated as one of the world’s greatest places to work.
Work schedule is full time.

Preferred start date: Depending on the request
End date: 6 months and very high possibility for longer and also to get a full time position at the client after a year. 
Location: Gävle, Sweden
Application
You will be employed by Temp-Team Sweden, but working full-time at our client’s location. Our client wishes for the right candidate to be hired asap, thus we are reviewing applications and inviting for interviews on an ongoing basis. If you are interested and feel you are the right person for the job, send us a targeted CV in English as soon as possible. 
It is very important that you communicate your experience within the above mentioned job details and requirements in your resume.
For any questions regarding the position please contact Elnaz Memarian at elm@temp-team.se or Kristina Gelevska at kga@temp-team.se

jobs.occupation: Danish speaking Customer Service Representative for SAS!
jobs.description:
Concentrix is a global company specializing in technology and services, supporting the brands of the future in more than 70 countries. With some of the world’s largest and most well-known brands in our client portfolio, there is a high chance that you have already interacted with one of our 440,000 Concentrix employees. Our game-changers deliver world-class customer service for our clients’ customers, helping businesses grow and build strong relationships.
If you want to be inspired and grow in your career, we encourage you to apply for the role of Travel Agent for our brand-new client SAS and become part of our global network of employees. You will be part of the team creating outstanding customer service experiences for SAS’ private customers. In this role, you will work from our office in Helsingborg, Sweden.
About the Role
Your daily work will involve providing world-class support via phone and chat to SAS’ Danish private customers. This may include inquiries regarding flight reservations, payments, refunds, and online services, to mention just a few. You will also be responsible for providing information about flight schedules, available destinations, and special requirements (wheelchair passengers, traveling with pets, etc.). In addition, you will be an expert in planning and proposing smart solutions for customers in difficult situations such as canceled flights, delays, or schedule changes.
To Thrive in This Role
We are looking for someone who is an excellent listener, proactive, and always strives to create an outstanding customer experience. You are naturally positive and energetic and balance professionalism with personality and engagement. You are good at expressing and explaining yourself both verbally and in writing. You enjoy working independently and are flexible when it comes to changes in your work. Stress tolerance is an important quality to succeed in this role.
You speak and write Danish fluently (C1) and English (B2).
You can work within the opening hours Monday–Friday 07:00–19:15 and weekends 09:00–18:15.
You can work from our office in Helsingborg.
You are at least 18 years old.
You have good computer skills.
6 months of customer contact experience.

What We Offer
We will ensure you have the best opportunities to succeed in this role by offering a 7-week training program combining practical training and hands-on experience. You will work with modern equipment and support staff who will help you develop into an excellent customer representative. In addition, you will receive regular feedback to support your development. At Concentrix, there is always a career path for those who want it—nearly 80% of our team leaders have been promoted internally.
A total of 7 weeks of training.
The opportunity to start something completely new together with dedicated colleagues.
25 paid vacation days per year as well as other benefits.
Internal career programs.

Job Details
Start date: 2027-01-04
Employment type: Full-time with a 6-month probation period
Working hours: Monday–Friday 07:00–19:15 and weekends 09:00–18:15 (your shifts will be scheduled within these hours, 40 hours/week)
Location: Concentrix office in Helsingborg, Rönnowsgatan 8c

Drive Strategy. Lead Growth. Make an Impact.
Instabee is changing the way last-mile deliveries work in Europe. We make online shopping faster, smarter, and more convenient. In Finland, we’ve scaled quickly—but we’re just getting started. Now, we need a strategic powerhouse to help shape our expansion, drive high-impact projects, and turn opportunities into growth.
If you’re an analytical problem solver who thrives on tackling complex business challenges, working cross-functionally, and translating strategy into execution, let’s talk.

🤝 Work with Leadership – Collaborate closely with the Country Manager and senior team to set targets and implement strategic plans.
📊 Use Data to Drive Decisions – Monitor performance, track key business metrics, and adjust strategies based on insights.
⚡ Remove Roadblocks – Identify challenges, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure our strategic initiatives run smoothly.
🚀 Think Big, Plan for the Future – We’re looking for someone with the ambition and potential to grow into a larger leadership role over time.
Who You Are
✅ A Strategic Thinker with a Commercial Edge – You have experience in strategy, management consulting, investment banking, or business development. Start-up/scale-up experience is a bonus.
✅ A Problem-Solver Who Gets Things Done – You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership, and know how to move projects forward.
✅ A Data-Driven Decision Maker – You use insights, analytics, and performance tracking to sharpen your approach and drive measurable impact.
✅ An Effective Communicator – You can turn complex ideas into clear, actionable plans and collaborate across teams.
✅ Experience Matters Most, but Education Helps – you have probably Master’s degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related field
✅ Fluent in English (Finnish is a bonus) – You can communicate clearly and persuasively in a fast-moving, international environment.
Why Instabee?
🌍 Join a Fast-Growing Company – Be part of a team that’s reshaping e-commerce logistics in Europe.
🚀 Advance Your Career – This role is built for growth, with a path toward broader leadership.
🏢 Work Flexibly – Hybrid setup with a modern Helsinki office centrally located in Kluuvi.
💡 Work with Cutting-Edge Tech – Shape the future of logistics with smart, data-driven solutions.
🎉 A Culture That Values Action – We move fast, make decisions quickly, and focus on what works.
Ready to Make an Impact? We’re looking for someone who’s ready to own projects, drive strategy, and shape the future of Instabee in Finland. If that’s you, apply today.
About Instabee
Instabee was founded in 2022 after combining Budbee and Instabox — two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox and Porterbuddy. Instabee is present in six countries, serving thousands of online merchants, including ASOS, Zalando, Inditex and H&M and is on track to become the most admired European e-commerce enabler.
In Finland, Budbee has been a key player since 2018 — and we’re moving fast.

Smart High Tech is transforming breakthrough graphene technology into an industrial reality.

Your Mission
You will act as the technical bridge between R&D and Production, ensuring our products can be manufactured efficiently, consistently and at scale.
Your mission is to:

Establish robust manufacturing methods.

Support production scale-up and operational excellence.

At Proposales, we're transforming how hotels sell and manage Groups, Meetings & Events. We're building a modern product platform for an industry that still relies heavily on legacy systems and manual processes, helping hotels move from inquiry to booking and delivery through beautifully designed software, automation and AI. It all runs in one connected flow, where prices, taxes and payments have to add up.
We're now expanding beyond a proposal tool into a complete AI-powered platform for group sales and event management. As Full-Stack Engineer (Payments) you'll own the payment infrastructure across our different products. You'll join an experienced engineering team where good ideas win arguments. Expect us to challenge your designs, and expect to challenge ours. The role is based at our HQ in Stockholm, fully on-site.
Your mission:

Own our payment infrastructure from idea to launch: shape the scope with product and leadership, design it, build it and follow it into use.

Design and build our payment provider integrations, covering payments, refunds, webhooks, payouts and reconciliation.

Make architecture decisions for flows where a mistake costs a hotel real money, with idempotency, retries and clear audit trails built in from the start.

Work across the rest of the platform too, in a TypeScript codebase that handles real bookings for hotels in more than 40 countries.

Review your colleagues' code, and have yours reviewed.

Work with finance and customer success to understand how hotels actually get paid, and turn that into product decisions.

Ensure secure and compliant payment operations, including PCI DSS, KYC, and evolving regulatory requirements as we scale our payments offering.

A bit about you:

You have built and run payment systems in production, and you know what breaks in them.

Hands-on experience integrating payment providers. You can walk us through an integration you built and the decisions behind it.

You understand finance and fintech: how money moves, settlement, fees, currencies and reconciliation.

You review AI-generated code as carefully as your own.

You care that money is correct to the cent, and that code is still easy to change a year later.

Experience with several payment providers, or with hospitality tech, is a strong plus.

Fluent English, written and spoken.

You live in Stockholm, and want to work on-site with your team.

Some of the technologies you'll work with:

TypeScript, React, Next.js

Node.js, PostgreSQL

Payment provider integrations

Vercel, AWS

What we offer:

Real ownership. Payments is a growing part of Proposales, so you'll shape how it's built instead of inheriting someone else's design.

Problems worth solving. Many currencies, tax rules and hotel systems, all in one flow that has to add up.

A proven product. Proposales has been recognised as #1 in the Hotel Tech Awards for five consecutive years and is listed on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 as one of the fastest-growing technology companies in the EMEA region.

Short decision lines. You'll work closely with leadership, and your ideas turn into action quickly.

Competitive salary that reflects your experience.

A personal development and wellbeing budget to invest in yourself.

A small, international, close-knit team in our Stockholm office, with an annual meetup and regular team activities.

How we work:
In payments, being correct matters more than being fast. Code goes through review, and the critical parts are covered by tests before anything reaches customers. We use AI agents every day: they speed up the work, but engineers own the design and the code. We're serverless first, hosted on Vercel.
